items.title: The wearable future is stuck in weird, experimental, existential limbo
items.excerpt: Victoria Song argues the AI-wearable category has stalled between half-shipped features and beta health sensing — devices that promise an ambient assistant but deliver a hamster wheel of unfinished promises. A product-design read on why wearable AI keeps missing.

items.title: Google's Pixel Watch 5 is promising — but it isn't finished
items.excerpt: A 'part one' review of a wearable that ships before its AI features do: most of the marquee Gemini and health capabilities aren't live yet, leaving hardware that's good and software that's a promissory note.

items.title: This app makes the Pixel 11's HiLight feature actually useful
items.excerpt: Third-party devs reverse-engineered control of the Pixel 11 Pro's HiLight hardware, turning a locked-down flagship feature into a programmable creative tool. A live example of users redesigning a device affordance the vendor shipped closed.

items.title: Waymo lifts the lid on the 'brain' powering its robotaxis
items.excerpt: Waymo detailed the custom silicon and compute stack running inference on-vehicle — a rare public look at how much edge AI hardware a fully autonomous product actually needs.
items.note: og article:published_time. Gated FRESH. Edge-AI hardware angle; drop if curator reads it as auto-industry rather than gadget.

items.title: XREAL teases the price of its Android XR glasses as early-bird deal sells out
items.excerpt: XREAL's Aura — the first consumer glasses running Google's Android XR — is closing in on a price reveal after its $99 reservation tier sold out, setting up a non-Meta challenger in the AI glasses category.

items.title: Pixel 11 Gboard Writing tools offer 'Personalized suggestions' with Gemini Intelligence
items.excerpt: Gboard's Writing tools on Pixel 11 now use on-device Gemini Intelligence to tailor rewrite suggestions to how you actually type — personalization pushed down into the keyboard layer rather than a separate assistant app.

items.title: Google Home update lets you set light color temperature by kelvin using voice commands
items.excerpt: A Gemini-era Google Home update finally accepts precise natural-language parameters — naming a kelvin value instead of 'warmer' — closing a long-standing gap between conversational input and exact device control.

items.title: Gemini for Home sharpens Spotify control, lighting tweaks, and message broadcasts
items.excerpt: Google shipped a Gemini for Home update targeting the three things the assistant most often got wrong — media selection, lighting control, and household broadcasts — a case study in fixing assistant reliability rather than adding capability.

items.title: Google built a camera-based tool to estimate body fat more accurately than wearables
items.excerpt: Google Research says a photo-based body composition model beats smartwatch and smart-scale estimates — suggesting the phone camera, not the sensor-laden wearable, may become the health-tracking input.

items.title: Google could soon make it easier to ask Gemini to take a look at things
items.excerpt: An APK teardown shows Google adding a shortcut that drops straight into Gemini Guided Vision camera mode — reducing the number of taps between 'I need help seeing this' and a live multimodal answer.

items.title: XREAL AURA Surpasses 10,000 Unit Reservations Ahead of Launch This Fall
items.excerpt: XREAL says the first Android XR AR glasses have topped 10,000 global reservations across consumers, developers and enterprise ahead of a $199 launch — an early demand signal for display glasses outside Meta's ecosystem.
items.note: og article:published_time. Gated FRESH. Overlaps the 9to5Google XREAL item — curator should pick one.

items.title: Pico's Vision Pro Competitor Gets Official Name and Debut Date
items.excerpt: ByteDance's Pico confirmed 'Pico Space Pro' — the Project Swan standalone headset — will debut at a Beijing event next month, putting a Chinese spatial-computing rival on the calendar.

items.title: Exclusive: Inside the Pixel Watch 5's breathing emergency detection — and why it's like an 'airbag on your wrist'
items.excerpt: Google's PM explains how on-wrist ML detects a breathing emergency and escalates without user input, plus new blood-pressure and insulin-resistance trends. A look at designing AI that must act silently and only when it matters.

items.title: 'Physical AI and robotics will take every physical task in the next 2-5 years': Neura Robotics CEO
items.excerpt: Neura Robotics' CEO makes an aggressive timeline claim for humanoid and cognitive robots moving from demo to deployment, and describes how the company designs machines meant to share human space.

items.title: Roborock Q7 M5+ review: A capable budget robot vacuum that nails the fundamentals
items.excerpt: A hands-on argument that reliable AI mapping and navigation have trickled down to budget robot vacuums, and that flagship 'robotic arm' features are still the optional part.

items.title: Apple's smart home springs a leak — here's everything we expect to see in September
items.excerpt: A rundown of Apple's rumored September home lineup, including a gen-AI Siri home hub — Apple's first real attempt to put an ambient assistant on a dedicated surface.

items.title: New 'HomePad' reveal is another reason to put it in every room of your house
items.excerpt: Apple's rumored HomePad will reportedly borrow Apple Watch-style customizable faces — an interface decision that treats an always-on AI home display as an ambient object first and an assistant second.

items.title: New Google Ad Shows a Mysterious Wearable. Is It the Next Fitbit?
items.excerpt: An unannounced Google wearable appears in a Pixel ad, hinting at a screenless AI-health form factor beyond the watch — the industrial-design tell before the product exists.

items.title: Whoop Expands Beyond Its Wearable Membership With Blood Tests
items.excerpt: Whoop opened its $150 diagnostics service — now including early cancer screening — to non-Whoop owners, decoupling its AI health model from its own hardware and turning the band into one input among many.

items.title: Google Pixel 11 series review: Is the magic fading?
items.excerpt: Ars finds the Gemini Intelligence-era Pixel making real compromises: the AI features are broader but the computational-photography magic that defined the line feels less distinctive.

items.title: Dell XPS 13 (2026) review: the new bar for mainstream Windows laptop excellence
items.excerpt: A Copilot+-class ultraportable review that weighs NPU-backed local AI features against battery, thermals and price — useful for designers sizing up a mainstream on-device AI machine.

items.title: Qualcomm retracts select Snapdragon C power efficiency benchmarks a week after publication
items.excerpt: Qualcomm quietly pulled idle-app and web-browsing efficiency results from its Snapdragon C slides, a reminder that AI-PC performance claims still need independent verification before they drive a hardware buy.
items.note: og article:published_time. Gated FRESH. Lowest design-relevance of the pool; include only if curator wants an AI-PC skeptic angle.
